title: Descent of a perfect complex
statement: Let R be a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings R_i, let X_i be a finitely presented R_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose base change to R is X, and let E be a perfect object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. After increasing i, there is a perfect object E_i of D(O_{X_i}) together with an isomorphism from its base change to E.

proof.text: Let $f:X\to X_i$ be the projection and, for $j\ge i$, $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R_i}\operatorname{Spec}R_j$. $X_i$ is finitely presented over $R_i$, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated; choose a finite cover of $X_i$ by affine opens $V^{(1)},\dots,V^{(n)}$ and put $W^{(k)}=V^{(1)}\cup\dots\cup V^{(k)}$. Each $W^{(k)}$ and each $W^{(k)}\cap V^{(k+1)}$ is a quasi-compact open of $X_i$ (quasi-separatedness), hence finitely presented over $R_i$, and its preimages in $X_j$ and $X$ are its base changes. We prove by induction on $k$ the assertion for $W^{(k)}$: after increasing $i$ there are a perfect $E_W$ on the preimage $W^{(k)}_i$ and an isomorphism $Lf^*E_W\cong E|_{f^{-1}W^{(k)}}$. The case $k=n$ is the lemma.

source.place: Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF, reduction to quasi-compact opens; induction along a finite affine cover (Cohomology of Schemes, Tag 01OY induction principle, case of finitely many affines)

proof.text: Affine case. For an affine member $V=V^{(k)}$, write $V_j=\operatorname{Spec}A_j$ for its preimage in $X_j$ and $f^{-1}V=\operatorname{Spec}A$ with $A=\operatorname{colim}_jA_j$ (affine transition morphisms). By [lem-pc-perfect-affine-bounded-projective], $E|_{f^{-1}V}\cong\widetilde{P^\bullet}$ for a bounded complex $P^\bullet$ of finite projective $A$-modules. By [lem-pc-affine-perfect-colimit-descent] there are $j$ and a bounded complex $P_j^\bullet$ of finite projective $A_j$-modules with $P_j^\bullet\otimes_{A_j}A\cong P^\bullet$. Then $E_V=\widetilde{P_j^\bullet}$ is strictly perfect, hence perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and since its terms are flat, $Lf^*\widetilde{P_j^\bullet}=\widetilde{P_j^\bullet\otimes_{A_j}A}\cong E|_{f^{-1}V}$.

source.place: Lemma 36.29.3, Tag 09RF, affine case via Lemmas 06Z0, 08EB and More on Algebra 0BC7

proof.text: Induction step. Let $W=W^{(k)}$, $V=V^{(k+1)}$ and, after increasing $i$, let $E_W$ on $W_i$ and $E_V$ on $V_i$ be perfect with isomorphisms $\phi_W:Lf^*E_W\to E|_{f^{-1}W}$ and $\phi_V:Lf^*E_V\to E|_{f^{-1}V}$ (induction hypothesis and Step 2). On the finitely presented $R_i$-scheme $W_i\cap V_i$ apply [lem-pc-perfect-descend-morphisms] to the isomorphism $\phi_V^{-1}\circ\phi_W$ restricted to $f^{-1}(W\cap V)$: after increasing $i$ there is an isomorphism $c:E_W|_{W_i\cap V_i}\to E_V|_{W_i\cap V_i}$ with $Lf^*c=\phi_V^{-1}\circ\phi_W$ there. Let $a:E_W\to(Rf_*E)|_{W_i}$ and $b:E_V\to(Rf_*E)|_{V_i}$ be adjoint to $\phi_W,\phi_V$ by [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint], using $(Rf_*E)|_{W_i}=R(f|_{f^{-1}W})_*(E|_{f^{-1}W})$ (Cohomology, Lemma 08FE); then $a=b\circ c$ on $W_i\cap V_i$ because $\phi_W=\phi_V\circ Lf^*c$ there. By [lem-sc-derived-open-gluing] on $W_i\cup V_i$ there are $F$ restricting to $E_W$ and $E_V$ with transition $c$, and a map $d:F\to(Rf_*E)|_{W_i\cup V_i}$ restricting to $a$ and $b$. $F$ is perfect, since perfectness is defined on an open cover [def-pc-perfect-complex]. The adjoint $Lf^*F\to E|_{f^{-1}(W\cup V)}$ of $d$ restricts to $\phi_W$ and $\phi_V$ on $f^{-1}W$ and $f^{-1}V$, which are isomorphisms; an arrow of a derived category of modules that is an isomorphism on each member of an open cover is an isomorphism (its cone has zero cohomology sheaves). This gives the assertion for $W^{(k+1)}$.

lean.statement: theorem perfect_complex_descends {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj i)] (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (s : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s] [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))) (hE : (pullback s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))).IsPerfect E) : ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (Ej : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))), (pullback s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).IsPerfect Ej ∧ Nonempty ((derivedPullback (baseChangeMap s (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))) (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j)) (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE hij)])))).obj Ej ≅ E)
